name: branding-supplement-tubs-on-fruit-colour-blocks-photo-grid
title: Sixteen photos of teal and blue vitamin tubs on beds of apples, peaches, berries, kiwis and oranges, plus a veg bag
whatItIs: A grid of vertical photos each showing a tub of a different variant (focus, magnesium, multi, probiotic) nestled among the fruit it relates to on white or fruit-filled backgrounds, with blocks of white podiums, scattered slices and two shots with a mesh bag of vegetables on blue tile.
whatItMeans: Fresh and appetising; matching ingredient photography makes each flavour feel real.
techniques: Style each variant with its own fruit.
Alternate dense fruit beds and airy scatter.
Use a blue tile scene for veg.

vocabulary.definition: Ingredients scattered around a product on white.
